metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows easy exercises to instantly get rid of fix stiff, achy lower back pain.

Each one of these exercises works a little differently. To get the best results, go through them all and use what works best for you.

As a bonus, all of the exercises can be done at home, require no equipment, and may give lower back pain relief within 30 seconds.

Watch now and instantly fix low back stiffness and tightness!
